module: Three "default" navigation guards of the router: navigation logging, blocking if the transition timeout is reached, blocking if a transition is already in progress (unless context.settings.force). Each receives (lifecycleName, context) and returns {result=boolean, context=...}.
notes: This module does not export an M.guards table: GuardManager.reloadGuards therefore does not register them, and GuardManager.executeGuards calls the guards with (route, params, context), a different signature from this one (lifecycleName, context). These functions seem to be an unconnected leftover in the current router (inferred from code).
handleTimeoutGuard calls TransitionManager.isTimeoutReached; the context receives reason="timeout_reached" or "transition_in_progress" when blocking.

handleTimeoutGuard.desc: Blocks the navigation if TransitionManager.isTimeoutReached() is true (context.reason = "timeout_reached").

handleTransitionStateGuard.desc: Allows if no transition is in progress or if context.settings.force is true; otherwise blocks with context.reason = "transition_in_progress".
